136	     2	
137	     3	## Problem & Idea
138	     4	
139	     5	Collaborative 3D authoring with AI agents is historically uncoordinated: without clear boundaries, multiple agents issuing concurrent commands overwrite scene state, scramble viewport context, and produce untraceable regressions.
140	     6	
141	     7	**ViewPoint Swarm** orchestrates multi-agent collaborative 3D asset generation ("StarForge Sentinel") on **one shared Blender 4.0.2 instance** [MEASURED] (job `vpswarm` running on a private Xvfb display `:2` [MEASURED]) governed by an explicit non-interactive turn queue:
142	     8	
143	     9	$$\text{THINK} \longrightarrow \text{ENQUEUE} \longrightarrow \text{TURN} \longrightarrow \text{RETURN}$$
144	    10	
145	    11	1. **Concurrent Reasoning, Serialized Actuation**: Agents inspect frozen rendered frames and plan/author scripts concurrently. However, actuation on the shared `.blend` file and viewport is strictly serialized one turn at a time by the broker's turn queue (`swarm/broker/broker.py`), preventing concurrent write hazards.
146	    12	2. **Disjoint Prefix Write-Set Claims**: Resource mutations are partitioned into explicit namespaces enforced by broker leases:
147	    13	   - `modeler-agent`: `col:CHAR_`, `obj:CHAR_`
148	    14	   - `props-agent`: `col:PROPS_`, `obj:PROP_`
149	    15	   - `look-agent`: `mat:`, `light:`, `world:`
150	    16	   - `camera-agent`: `cam:`, `render:`
151	    17	3. **Frame-Bound GUI Camera Orbits**: The `camera-agent` commands orbital viewport view adjustments with typed outcome classification: `STALE_FRAME`, `VERIFIED`, `VERIFIED_WITH_SPILL`, and `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`. Stale frames are detected against frame sidecars before execution.
152	    18	4. **Off-Display Overlay Composition**: An independent compositor (`swarm/overlay/compositor.py`) overlays per-agent colored cursors and a turn-queue status HUD directly onto the captured display video without injecting helper geometry into the Blender scene.
153	    19	5. **Live Projection**: Real-time agent status and turn results project to OpenSwitchboard (`viewpoint-capsule`) and TaskLight (`context-wall`) room cards (`swarm/projection/projector.py`).

+## Hackathon build (swarm-1114)
+
+The `swarm-1114` build introduces multi-agent collaborative 3D asset generation on **one shared Blender 4.0.2 instance** [MEASURED] (`vpswarm` on private Xvfb `:2` [MEASURED]), coordinated by an explicit non-interactive turn queue (`THINK -> ENQUEUE -> TURN -> RETURN`). Headless agents (`modeler-agent`, `props-agent`, `look-agent`, `camera-agent`) reason concurrently over frozen frames, while scene mutations and viewport camera adjustments are serialized one turn at a time through disjoint prefix write-set leases (`col:CHAR_`, `obj:CHAR_`, `col:PROPS_`, `obj:PROP_`, `mat:`, `light:`, `world:`, `cam:`, `render:`).
+
+### Two-Track Declaration
+
+1. **Track H (`swarm/`) — Hackathon-Claimed Code**:
+   Authored exclusively by autonomous Gemini models (`gemini-4-hydrogen-high`, `gemini-4-carbon-high`, `gemini-3.8-flash-high`) via `agy --output-format stream-json` after 08:59 CET [CITED] on Saturday 14 Nov 2026. Cryptographic SHA-256 receipts for all 15 generation proof logs are indexed in [swarm/docs/PROOF.md](swarm/docs/PROOF.md).
+2. **Track P (`product/`) — Declared Non-Gemini Product & Adversarial Work**:
+   Authored by Anthropic models (`claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-fable-5-2`) via `claude -p --verbose` prior to 13:59 CET [CITED] as declared product explorations (`product/admission/`, `product/fanout/`, `product/mpx/REPORT.md`) and findings-only adversarial reviews (`product/reviews/`, `product/repair_specs/REPAIR_SPECS.md`, `product/comparison/H_VS_REF_REPORT.md`). Exactly 0 files [MEASURED] were written under `swarm/`. Track P code is never imported into `swarm/` or claimed as Gemini-generated.
+
+### Honest Process Boundary & Projection Guarantee
+
+> "Browser capsules (measured 13 Nov) run as containers with their own display. Today's Blender 4.0.2 swarm capsule runs as host processes inside `systemd-run` memory-capped scopes on a private Xvfb display (`:2`) under one shared UID: per-run bridge nonces and prefix claims catch accidental cross-writes, stale frames, and buggy agents, and are not an OS security boundary against a hostile same-UID process. Per-agent UIDs/containers are roadmap work."
+
+Projection to OpenSwitchboard (`viewpoint-capsule`) and TaskLight (`context-wall`) is best-effort; `swarm/run/events.jsonl` is the authoritative local record of truth, audited at end-of-run by `reconciler.py` (`--finalize`).
+
+### Measured Results & Live Gate
+
+- **Unit Test Suites**:
+  - `H1` broker + bridge: `19/19` tests passing [MEASURED]
+  - `H2` agents + runner: `19/19` tests passing [MEASURED]
+  - `H3` overlay compositor: `15/15` tests passing [MEASURED]
+  - `H4` projection + reconciler: `29/29` tests passing [MEASURED]
+- **Wave 1 Live Gate (`take1_w1_2agents`)**:
+  - Broker events recorded: `100` [MEASURED]
+  - Verified agent turns executed: `7` [MEASURED]
+  - Exported 3D asset (`starforge_sentinel.glb`): `16` meshes [MEASURED], `1340` vertices [MEASURED], `2368` polygons [MEASURED]
+  - End-of-run reconciliation audit (`reconciler.py --finalize`): `CLEAN` [MEASURED]

     1	# IDEA — ViewPoint Swarm: Multi-Agent 3D Capsule Studio (`ONE_PAGER_IDEA.md`)
     2	
     3	## Problem & Idea
     4	
     5	Collaborative 3D authoring with AI agents is historically uncoordinated: without clear boundaries, multiple agents issuing concurrent commands overwrite scene state, scramble viewport context, and produce untraceable regressions.
     6	
     7	**ViewPoint Swarm** orchestrates multi-agent collaborative 3D asset generation ("StarForge Sentinel") on **one shared Blender 4.0.2 instance** [MEASURED] (job `vpswarm` running on a private Xvfb display `:2` [MEASURED]) governed by an explicit non-interactive turn queue:
     8	
     9	$$\text{THINK} \longrightarrow \text{ENQUEUE} \longrightarrow \text{TURN} \longrightarrow \text{RETURN}$$
    10	
    11	1. **Concurrent Reasoning, Serialized Actuation**: Agents inspect frozen rendered frames and plan/author scripts concurrently. However, actuation on the shared `.blend` file and viewport is strictly serialized one turn at a time by the broker's turn queue (`swarm/broker/broker.py`), preventing concurrent write hazards.
    12	2. **Disjoint Prefix Write-Set Claims**: Resource mutations are partitioned into explicit namespaces enforced by broker leases:
    13	   - `modeler-agent`: `col:CHAR_`, `obj:CHAR_`
    14	   - `props-agent`: `col:PROPS_`, `obj:PROP_`
    15	   - `look-agent`: `mat:`, `light:`, `world:`
    16	   - `camera-agent`: `cam:`, `render:`
    17	3. **Frame-Bound GUI Camera Orbits**: The `camera-agent` commands orbital viewport view adjustments with typed outcome classification: `STALE_FRAME`, `VERIFIED`, `VERIFIED_WITH_SPILL`, and `NO_VISIBLE_CHANGE`. Stale frames are detected against frame sidecars before execution.
    18	4. **Off-Display Overlay Composition**: An independent compositor (`swarm/overlay/compositor.py`) overlays per-agent colored cursors and a turn-queue status HUD directly onto the captured display video without injecting helper geometry into the Blender scene.
    19	5. **Live Projection**: Real-time agent status and turn results project to OpenSwitchboard (`viewpoint-capsule`) and TaskLight (`context-wall`) room cards (`swarm/projection/projector.py`).
    20

    parser.add_argument(
        "--finalize",
        action="store_true",
        help="Close open tasks and run reconciler audit on completion",
    )
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s")

    # Instantiate chosen sink
    if args.sink == "dry-run":
        sink: BaseSink = DryRunSink(cw_home=args.cw_home)
    elif args.sink == "osb":
        sink = OsbSink()
    elif args.sink == "mcp":
        sink = TaskLightMcpSink(cw_home=args.cw_home)
    else:
        sink = CompositeSink([
            OsbSink(),
            TaskLightMcpSink(cw_home=args.cw_home),
        ])

    projector = Projector(
        events_file=args.events_file,
        state_file=args.state_file,
        sink=sink,
        osb_room=args.osb_room,
        cw_room=args.cw_room,
        cw_home=args.cw_home,
    )

    try:
        if args.follow:
            projector.run_follow()
        else:
            projector.run_once()

        if args.finalize:
            report = projector.finalize()
            print(json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2))
            return 0 if report.clean else 1

        return 0
    finally:
        projector.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    def test_d1_committed_links_pass(self):
        """D1 Pass: All Markdown links and backticked repo paths across docs exist in git HEAD."""
        all_errors = []
        # Check README.md
        readme_path = os.path.join(self.repo_root, "README.md")
        with open(readme_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            readme_text = f.read()
        all_errors.extend(validate_links_in_content(readme_text, "README.md", self.allowed_files))

        # Check swarm/docs/*.md
        for doc_rel in DOC_FILES:
            full_p = os.path.join(self.repo_root, doc_rel)
            with open(full_p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                content = f.read()

        self.assertEqual(all_errors, [], f"Found invalid links/paths: {all_errors}")

    def test_d1_must_fail_control(self):

            "Here is a reference to an uncommitted draft: [fake link](product/narrative/FAKE_UNTRACKED.md)."

        errors = validate_links_in_content(mutant_content, "swarm/docs/SAMPLE.md", self.allowed_files)
        self.assertTrue(len(errors) > 0, "D1 control FAILED: mutant link was not detected!")
        self.assertTrue(any("FAKE_UNTRACKED.md" in e for e in errors))

    def test_d2_proof_hashes_pass(self):

            proof_content = f.read()

</verdict>

## LIVE_PATH

| ID | Where | Defect | Repro |
|---|---|---|---|

## Gates

| Gate | Result | Evidence [MEASURED] |
|---|---|---|
| Unit suite | PASS | `10/10` OK in `0.024–0.027 s` over 3 runs |
| D1 links and citations | PASS | `11/11` links resolve to `HEAD ∪ swarm/docs/*`; `0` untracked worktree citations; all 4 `swarm/viewer/` mentions carry `[TARGET]` |
| D2 proof re-hash | PASS | `33/33` proof logs match disk and `PROVENANCE.md`; `0` missing rows; `10/10` design inputs match; `33/33` in-log model fields equal the declared model |
| D3 anti-overclaim | PASS on wording | `0` banned-phrase hits, including `isolated` and `in parallel`; both mandated statements are verbatim in `README.md:114,116` and `ONE_PAGER_IDEA.md:38,42` |
| D4 two-track and README preservation | PASS | `git diff --numstat README.md` = `38` insertions, `0` deletions; `H0..H6` and `P1..P6` attributions match `PROVENANCE.md` and the logs |

- **Live-gate numbers:** `100` events, `7` verified turns, `16`/`1340`/`2368` and `CLEAN` all re-derive from the runtime evidence in `swarm/run/`.
- **"0 files under `swarm/`" by Track P:** the 18 Track P logs contain `33` `Write`/`Edit` calls, `0` of them targeting `swarm/` or `README.md`. Writes made through `Bash` are not covered by this probe.
- **Not re-probed:** Blender `4.0.2` and Xvfb `:2` (AUSENTE — no inventar); the `H1..H4` and `P1`/`P2` test counts are taken from `PROVENANCE.md` [CITED].

## BACKLOG worth acting on before the tag

- **`BL-1` (director):** the "all 15" Track H receipts claim holds for `HEAD`, but `H5` and `H6` are claimed as Gemini-authored with no `PROOF.md` or `PROVENANCE.md` row. `H5_1333.jsonl` and `H6_1333.jsonl` are still untracked.
- **`BL-2` (director):** "prior to 13:59 CET" for all Track P work becomes false if any Track P round, such as a re-review of `H6_r1`, lands after that time.
- **`BL-4`:** the live-gate summary omits that `8` turns were enqueued with `1` modeler `JOB_ERROR` and `1` refusal, and that the 16th mesh is Blender's default `Cube`.
- **`BL-8`:** `test_docs.py` lets `7` planted defects through, including fake `product/proof/P4_*` paths, 3 deleted proof rows, an altered `PROVENANCE.md` hash, "fully isolated", and deletion of a pre-existing README section. None of these affects the current docs.

The remaining five (`BL-3`, `BL-5`, `BL-6`, `BL-7`, `BL-9`) are wording and cosmetic items, listed in the review file.

Enlaces, hashes (`33/33`), frases prohibidas y preservación del README pasan. Un `H6_r1` de 3 líneas lo desbloquea; `BL-1` y `BL-2` son del director.
</operator_summary_es>

- Every unit-suite, audit and mutation run used the mandated `systemd-run` scope with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`; read-only shell one-liners (`git`, `sha256sum`, `uname`, `grep`, JSON tallies of `events.jsonl`) and the probe-copy `git clone` ran outside it.
- `LP-1` rests on `uname -r`; that `grep` finds no `uname` call in the H6 stream is weak corroboration only, since the stream may not log every command.
</self_audit>
